# möbius for macOS 0.3.12

- Open a Bot's computer beside its chat. Cloud desktops support watching, taking control, and pasting from this Mac; local Bots share the same embedded Chrome tab with the agent.
- Computer views show the gateway's connection state, preserve the selected chat when reused, and release their stream and control when closed.
- Fix desktop rendering, stalled desktop transfers, and the ownership pill's accent background.
- Preserve every non-empty unsent draft across launches and report browser input that cannot be queued.

Includes Core and gateway 0.16.7. Requires Apple Silicon, macOS 26 or later, and gateway protocol 89.
